children: Hub Group entered into a Third Amendment to its Credit Agreement to provide temporary covenant flexibility amid delayed filings and restatement work. The amendment extends the deadlines to deliver certain 2025 audited and 2026 unaudited financial statements to November 30, 2026. It also modifies the EBITDA definition to add back specified restatement-related expenses incurred on or before December 31, 2026. Management expects the changes to support liquidity and compliance while it completes its financial restatement.
